svg.title: Logger — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as logger, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A compact chainsaw has a long rounded bar and two separately visible raised handles. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
